name: Abe no Seimei
source:
Hobby: Seeing Beautiful Views

This unparalleled Onmyoji is a genius for writing, fighting, or maybe everything. He has an isolated and mystical character and never opens his heart to anyone.

[From [url=https://akasekaeng.ppgame.com/miyabi.html]English official site[/url]]
